cards.name: Instant Pot Duo 6-Quart 7-in-1
cards.badge: Product of the day · a proven pressure cooker, best on sale
cards.price: List $109.99 at Instant Pot's store; Target $79.99 and Home Depot $128.73 (search snippets, Oct 2026, unconfirmed); past sales about 30%–40% off list
cards.buy_if: you want a straightforward pressure cooker for rice, beans, stews and chili for 2 to 5 people, ideally at a sale price.
cards.skip_if: you mainly want a slow cooker or an air fryer: America's Test Kitchen found the Duo slow-cooks poorly; look at the Cosori 6-quart or the Duo Crisp.
cards.owners: A search summary of a Walmart listing showed 4.6 out of 5 (Oct 5, 2026; count not visible). Praised for speed and the easy-clean steel pot; the gasket is fiddly and a few units failed within 30–45 days.
